name: Napalm's debuff text states the per-stack increase the client data omits
contract: Napalm 805315 is the Tinker debuff applied by direct Fire damage. Its client
Spell.dbc text says Fire damage taken 'is increased' with no amount and no
per-stack statement. The server adds +3% Fire damage taken per stack (Effect 0
base points 2, read by the scaling script) up to 10 stacks over 8 s, with a
flat -3% healing received. The fix publishes the corrected Description and
ToolTip through coa_client_spell_description, baked into the client's
spell rows. This scenario reads the client rows: row 500639
(Runeshroud) is the control proving the client rows are read, and row 805315 must
carry the per-stack line in both columns.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle

CLIENT ROW: Napalm (805315) carries the dynamic per-stack Description line
CLIENT ROW: the same row keeps the dynamic healing variable and carries the ToolTip line for the unit-frame debuff hover
